'''Nerrif''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="o66" />

Near the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] squads [[Omega Squad|Omega]] and [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta]] were redeployed from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Haurgab]] to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] via Nerrif. It was here that [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Etain Tur-Mukan]] revealed to her lover [[Darman Skirata]], a [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] of Omega Squad, that they had a son, [[Venku Skirata]].<ref name="o66" />
